# Third-party frontend libraries

Vendored for CSP-safe, same-origin delivery.

| Library | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| cytoscape | 3.30.4 | MIT | https://unpkg.com/cytoscape@3.30.4/ |
| cose-base | 2.2.0 | MIT | https://unpkg.com/cose-base@2.2.0/ |
| layout-base | 2.0.1 | MIT | https://unpkg.com/layout-base@2.0.1/ |
| cytoscape-cose-bilkent | 4.1.0 | MIT | https://unpkg.com/cytoscape-cose-bilkent@4.1.0/ |
| dagre | 0.8.5 | MIT | https://unpkg.com/dagre@0.8.5/ |
| cytoscape-dagre | 2.5.0 | MIT | https://unpkg.com/cytoscape-dagre@2.5.0/ |
| sql.js | 1.10.3 | MIT | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sql.js@1.10.3/ |

Pyodide remains path-scoped from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/<version>/full/`
and is not vendored.
